candidates.reason: A shrunk copy of the square layout dropped into the middle of the tall canvas. The body copy, CTA label and footnote are unreadably tiny, the logo is a speck, and roughly 60% of the canvas (top and bottom) is empty background.

Good vertical stack and a full-width CTA, but the headline is indented about 40 px while the body, CTA and footnote sit at about 12 px, so there are two ragged left edges. The centred logo fights the left-aligned text, and the body copy is small next to the headline.

The logo is tiny and jammed into the top-left corner against the 'Golden' headline, so the wordmark looks clipped (brand damage). The body copy is nearly headline-weight and crowds the product circle. The CTA and footnote are fine, but the top is cramped while the product area is loose.

Strong headline, then product, then copy, then CTA reading order, and the format fits. But the logo is a tiny mark crammed above the headline with no breathing room. The body copy is oversized and competes with the headline, and the CTA is inset from the text's left edge, so the alignment is slightly off.
